thread:
katie.peopleops: morning — quick onboarding question. contractor starts today and needs a company iPad for user-testing. MDM enrollment keeps failing with 'certificate_untrusted' when they're on guest wifi. also: are contractors auto-excluded from phishing sims until contract paperwork is complete? who should I loop in? :wave:

alex.it: hey! guest networks often block our internal CA chain. ask them to plug into corp wired or join corp-guest-vpn during enrollment. if they can't, we can try installing the profile via Safari. can you paste the exact error?

katie.peopleops: here's the message they sent: `MDM enrollment failed: certificate_untrusted (com.redwood.mdm 0x103)`. screenshot uploaded to the ticket: https://redwood.tickets/C-5421/screenshot.png

jin.security: contractors are NOT auto-exempt from phish sims by default. we can grant a short grace period while access is being provisioned, but formal exemptions require security approval + ticket with contract ID. tagging @maya.security to assist. :lock:

maya.security: noted. we can do a 48h temporary exemption for phishing simulations while onboarding completes. please add contractor to the contractor_onboard Okta group and include contract ID in the ticket. contractors must complete security training within 7 days — we'll schedule reminder emails and Slack nudges.

alex.it: workaround that often works on iPad: Settings -> General -> Profiles -> tap the provisioning profile CA -> Trust -> then re-run enrollment. if that doesn't work, install the profile through Safari using our onboard endpoint. example we use internally: `curl -k https://mdm.redwood.internal/provision/profile.mobileconfig -o profile.mobileconfig` then open it on the iPad. (note: -k only used on internal network for self-signed chain; don't use publicly).

tyler.contractor: fwiw i'm on an Airalo eSIM and corp VPN won't come up — trying the Safari profile install now. will update.

jin.security: quick policy note — longer phishsim exemptions require badge + identity verification. temporary tag okay for immediate access issues, but include justification in the ticket (who, why, expiry).

katie.peopleops: creating ticket C-5421 with contract copy attached. requesting 48h phishsim grace and 7d training reminder. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

tyler.contractor: confirmed — installed via Safari and re-ran enroll. MDM shows status: "Compliant" in the app and corporate apps are being pushed. thanks for the assist!

alex.it: saw device come through JAMF: serial XXXXXXXXX — VPN/profile pushed. all good on infra side.

onboarding-bot: reminder scheduled: security-training (ID: C-5421) due in 7 days; phishsim exemption applied until 2026-03-30.

maya.security: closing loop — exemption set until 2026-03-30, training reminder queued. marking resolved on our side. :white_check_mark:
